content: Adolescents should restrict their dietary protein intake to levels recommended for their specific age group. Conduct annual screening for albuminuria by measuring the albumin-to-creatinine ratio. Annually assess the estimated glomerular filtration rate (eGFR) to monitor kidney function. Initiate treatment with angiotensin-converting enzyme (ACE) inhibitors or angiotensin receptor blockers (ARBs) in cases of elevated albumin-to-creatinine ratios, provided the eGFR remains within the normal range. If nephropathy progresses or there is a decline in eGFR, refer the patient to a nephrologist for specialized care.
